payout_quote: Refer friends and family to open a new ACCU Central Checking or Advantage Checking account. You'll both receive a $100 bonus! There is no limit to how many referrals you can earn!
steps: Complete the referral coupon with your member info and your friend/family member's info.
Turn the form in to your local Alabama Central Credit Union branch before your friend opens their account.
Friend opens a new Central Checking or Advantage Checking account and completes direct deposit or 10 debit transactions within the first 30 days.
catches: The referral form must be received BEFORE the new account is opened — post-opening referrals don't qualify.
Friend must complete direct deposit or 10 debit transactions within the first 30 days; no bonus if they don't.
Bonus timing not stated on the form — confirm with the branch.
Membership eligibility applies; Alabama Central is an AL credit union (field of membership rules).
biggest_catch: The coupon form has to be turned in to a branch before your friend opens the account — miss that ordering and the $100 is gone even if they qualify.
eligibility: Current Alabama Central Credit Union member; referred person must be a new member eligible for ACCU membership.
timing: Form handoff takes ~10 minutes; bonus payout timing not stated (confirm at branch).
